scope: Browser-only frontend evaluation. Use fictional data. Real payments, emails, reservations, authentication and external services are out of scope. Publishing is a separate optional check.

stages.name: Initial generation
stages.instruction: Submit the brief with the design direction and requirements. Record the exact prompt and first complete result.

stages.name: Functionality and interaction
stages.instruction: Exercise every acceptance check. Record working behavior as well as failures. Use keyboard navigation.

stages.name: Modification and instruction following
stages.instruction: Submit the assigned modification. Check that unrelated content, layout and working state are preserved.

stages.name: Debugging and edge cases
stages.instruction: Try the assigned edge cases. Report a reproducible failure, ask for one focused fix, and retest. If none fails, record that clearly; do not invent a bug.

stages.name: Final evaluation and submission
stages.instruction: Inspect 375px and 1440px layouts, score the result, attach evidence links, and submit. Check browser refresh recovery before final submission.

designRubric: Typography has a clear hierarchy and readable body text
Spacing, alignment and colors are consistent across views
Layout and wording fit the assigned business rather than generic filler
At least two concrete choices distinguish this design from the starter template
Keyboard focus, labels, contrast and mobile overflow are checked

ratings.4: Meets the brief with minor issues
ratings.5: Meets the brief consistently; supported by concrete examples

assignments.title: Mango Market
assignments.brief: Build a compact homewares storefront for Lagos shoppers using eight seeded products.
assignments.style: Warm editorial retail: cream, terracotta, large product names and a restrained product grid.
features: Filter by category and search product names
Add items, change quantities and remove items in a cart
Show accurate subtotal and a clearly labeled checkout simulation
checks: A category filter hides unrelated products
Adding an item twice produces quantity 2 and the correct total
Removing the last item shows an empty-cart state
Checkout never claims a real payment was processed
assignments.modify: Add a sale-only filter and a visible Reset filters control. Preserve cart contents and existing styling.
assignments.debug: Search for a nonexistent product, clear the search, then remove the last cart item. Report and ask the model to fix one observed failure. If none fails, ask it to verify those cases without claiming tests it did not run.

assignments.title: Pulse Operations
assignments.brief: Build a small operations dashboard with 12 seeded support tickets, team summaries and a ticket detail panel.
assignments.style: Calm indigo workspace, compact tables, clear hierarchy and useful empty states.
features: Filter tickets by status and search title
Open a ticket detail view and change its status locally
Update visible counts when a ticket changes
checks: Status filters and search work together
Ticket details match the selected row
Changing status changes the count and filtered list
Navigation shows distinct relevant content
assignments.modify: Add an overdue-only filter and a Reset filters control. Preserve ticket status changes.
assignments.debug: Apply a search with no results, then reset and change a ticket while its old status is selected. Report and request a focused fix if behavior is inconsistent.

assignments.title: Table Eight
assignments.brief: Build a restaurant ordering demo with eight dishes across three categories and a local order basket.
assignments.style: Contemporary restaurant menu: warm paper, dark type, green accents and readable prices.
features: Filter menu categories and dietary preferences
Add dishes and update basket quantities
Show an order summary and a clearly labeled simulated confirmation
checks: Dietary filter excludes unsuitable dishes
Basket total equals quantity times unit price
Removing all dishes leaves a usable empty state
Confirmation states that no order has been sent
assignments.modify: Add a vegetarian-only quick filter and Reset filters control. Preserve the basket.
assignments.debug: Combine dietary and category filters to get no results; reduce quantities to zero. Ask for a targeted correction to a reproducible problem.

assignments.title: Harbor Stay
assignments.brief: Build a hotel reservation demo with six seeded room types, guest counts and date inputs.
assignments.style: Quiet hospitality: sand and navy, generous spacing, clear room comparisons.
features: Filter by guest capacity and room type
Select check-in and check-out dates with validation
Show room details and a clearly labeled reservation summary
checks: Check-out before check-in is rejected with a useful message
Capacity filters exclude undersized rooms
The summary reflects the selected room and dates
No real reservation or payment is claimed
assignments.modify: Add a breakfast-included filter and Reset filters control. Preserve valid selected dates.
assignments.debug: Choose invalid dates and a guest count above every room capacity. Record what happens, then request a focused fix for one failure.

assignments.title: Skillpath
assignments.brief: Build a learner dashboard with six seeded courses and one three-question quiz.
assignments.style: Friendly learning workspace: light backgrounds, teal accents and concise progress indicators.
features: Search courses and filter by completion status
Open a course and mark a lesson complete locally
Submit a three-question quiz and show score and feedback
checks: Completing a lesson updates course progress
Course filters reflect changed progress
Quiz score matches the submitted answers
Resetting a quiz clears the previous score
assignments.modify: Add an in-progress quick filter and Reset filters control. Preserve completed lessons.
assignments.debug: Submit an unanswered quiz, answer it, then reset and retry. Report and request a correction for an observed scoring or state issue.

assignments.title: City Sessions
assignments.brief: Build an event ticketing demo with eight seeded events and ticket quantities.
assignments.style: Expressive event guide: bold headings, dark ink, one vivid accent and practical information density.
features: Search events and filter by category
Open event details and select ticket quantity
Show totals and a clearly labeled booking simulation
checks: Filters and search combine correctly
Quantity limits prevent negative or excessive tickets
Totals reflect the selected ticket count
Booking confirmation says it is a demo
assignments.modify: Add a free-events-only filter and Reset filters control. Preserve a current ticket selection.
assignments.debug: Search with no matches and try zero or excessive ticket quantities. Ask for a fix to one reproducible validation problem.

assignments.title: Workline
assignments.brief: Build a job marketplace demo with eight seeded roles and a local application form.
assignments.style: Clear recruitment board: neutral palette, strong role titles and legible location and salary metadata.
features: Search job titles and filter remote/on-site roles
Open job details and save or unsave a role locally
Validate a demo application form and show a simulated confirmation
checks: Remote filter removes on-site roles
Saved state remains consistent between list and detail
Blank required fields and invalid email are rejected
Confirmation never claims an application was sent
assignments.modify: Add a saved-only filter and Reset filters control. Preserve saved roles.
assignments.debug: Submit a blank application, then an invalid email and then valid demo data. Record and request a fix for an observed validation failure.

assignments.title: Ledger View
assignments.brief: Build a personal spending dashboard with 12 seeded transactions and a locally drawn category chart. Use fictional data.
assignments.style: Trustworthy financial interface: restrained blue, clear numbers, aligned tables and accessible chart labels.
features: Filter transactions by category and search description
Show totals that update with the visible data
Open transaction details and switch between chart and table views
checks: Category totals match the seeded transactions
Search and filters combine correctly
Chart has an equivalent readable table or labels
Empty results show zero and no misleading chart values
assignments.modify: Add an expenses-only filter and Reset filters control. Preserve the selected view.
assignments.debug: Filter to no transactions and check totals, then reset and compare chart values with the table. Ask for a focused fix if they disagree.
